## Read Data

```{r}
data <- read_csv("w1-full-battery-scored.csv")
```

## Descriptive Statistics

```{r}
data |>
  psych::describe()
```

```{r}
df <- read_csv("w1-full-battery-scored.csv")
df <- df %>% select(-SID, -site) |> drop_na()

# Pastel palette
pastel_colors <- c("#AEC6CF", "#FFB347", "#B39EB5", "#77DD77", "#F49AC2")

# Loop through columns and plot
for (i in seq_along(df)) {
  col_name <- names(df)[i]
  color <- pastel_colors[(i - 1) %% length(pastel_colors) + 1]
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes_string(x = col_name)) +
    geom_density(fill = color, alpha = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +  # Eyeliner, baby
    labs(title = paste("Density Plot of", col_name)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_blank()
    )
  
  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
shapiro_results <- df |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ list(shapiro.test(.x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "test") |>
  mutate(
    statistic = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$statistic),
    p_value = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$p.value)
  ) |>
  select(variable, statistic, p_value)

shapiro_results
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 7
#| 
corr <- cor(df)
corr_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(corr))

ggplot(corr_df, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#d0d1e6", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#1c9099", midpoint = 0) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Correlation Heatmap", x = "", y = "") +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
pastel_points <- c("#FBB4AE", "#B3CDE3", "#CCEBC5", "#DECBE4")
pastel_lines <- c("#FDBE85", "#A6CEE3", "#B2DF8A", "#CAB2D6")

# Generate all unique variable pairs
pairs <- combn(names(df), 2, simplify = FALSE)

# Loop through pairs and make pastel scatter plots
for (i in seq_along(pairs)) {
  pair <- pairs[[i]]
  x_var <- pair[1]
  y_var <- pair[2]
  
  # Correlation stuff
  test <- cor.test(df[[x_var]], df[[y_var]])
  r_val <- round(test$estimate, 2)
  p_val <- signif(test$p.value, 2)
  label <- paste0("r = ", r_val, ", p = ", p_val)
  
  # Pick pastel colors
  point_color <- pastel_points[(i - 1) %% length(pastel_points) + 1]
  line_color <- pastel_lines[(i - 1) %% length(pastel_lines) + 1]
  
  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(df, aes_string(x = x_var, y = y_var)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, color = point_color, size = 2.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = line_color, fill = line_color, alpha = 0.3) +
    annotate("text",
             x = Inf, y = -Inf,
             label = label,
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5,
             size = 5, fontface = "italic") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Scatterplot of", y_var, "vs", x_var),
      x = x_var,
      y = y_var
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15)
  
  print(p)
}
```

## Supervised Models

### XGBoost

```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(vip)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)


targets <- names(df)

run_model <- function(target, data) {
  rec <- recipe(as.formula(paste(target, "~ .")), data = data) |>
    step_impute_median(all_predictors()) |>  # Handle NAs here if any exist
    step_normalize(all_predictors())

  xgb_spec <- boost_tree(
    trees = tune(),
    tree_depth = tune(),
    learn_rate = tune(),
    loss_reduction = tune(),
    sample_size = tune(),
    mtry = tune()
  ) |>
    set_engine("xgboost") |>
    set_mode("regression")

  wf <- workflow() |>
    add_model(xgb_spec) |>
    add_recipe(rec)

  folds <- vfold_cv(data, v = 5)

  grid_vals <- grid_latin_hypercube(
    trees(),
    tree_depth(),
    learn_rate(),
    loss_reduction(),
    sample_size = sample_prop(),
    finalize(mtry(), data %>% select(-all_of(target))),
    size = 15
  )

  tuned <- tune_grid(
    wf,
    resamples = folds,
    grid = grid_vals,
    metrics = metric_set(rmse, rsq),
    control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
  )

  best <- select_best(tuned, metric = "rmse")

  final_wf <- finalize_workflow(wf, best)
  final_fit <- fit(final_wf, data = data)

  preds_train <- predict(final_fit, data) |>
    bind_cols(data %>% select(!!target))
  colnames(preds_train) <- c("prediction", "truth")
  rsq_train <- rsq(preds_train, truth = truth, estimate = prediction) |> pull(.estimate)

  best_config <- best %>% select(-.config)
  tuned_metrics <- collect_predictions(tuned) |>
    inner_join(best_config, by = colnames(best_config)) |>
    group_by(id) |>
    rsq(truth = !!sym(target), estimate = .pred) |>
    summarise(cv_rsq = mean(.estimate))

  rsq_cv <- mean(tuned_metrics$cv_rsq)

  imp <- final_fit |>
    pull_workflow_fit() |>
    vip::vi(type = "gain") |>
    mutate(
      NormalizedGain = Importance / sum(Importance),
      Target = target
    )

  list(
    target = target,
    rmse = show_best(tuned, metric = "rmse", n = 1),
    rsq_train = rsq_train,
    rsq_cv = rsq_cv,
    workflow = final_wf,
    fit = final_fit,
    importance = imp
  )
}

# Run all models
results <- map(targets, ~ run_model(.x, df))

# Generate and print one plot per target
walk(results, function(res) {
  imp_plot <- ggplot(res$importance, aes(x = reorder(Variable, NormalizedGain), y = NormalizedGain, fill = Target)) +
    geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Normalized XGBoost Feature Importance (Gain) for", res$target),
      x = "Features", y = "Normalized Gain"
    )
  print(imp_plot)

  # Print model metrics
  cat("\nTarget:", res$target, "\n")
  print(res$rmse)
  cat("R² (Train):", round(res$rsq_train, 4), "\n")
  cat("R² (Cross-validated):", round(res$rsq_cv, 4), "\n")
})

```
